description: This file defines the class SugarVCR which manages session-based storage and navigation of query results within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for storing and retrieving query data, navigating through record sets, and generating UI elements for record navigation.

classes.name: SugarVCR
classes.description: Handles session-based query storage, navigation, and UI rendering for record sets in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a query string for a specific module in the session.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the stored query string for a specific module from the session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Generates navigation details (previous, current, next IDs) for a given module and offset.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Produces HTML for record navigation controls, including links for previous, next, and record management.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Fetches a set of record IDs from the database based on current query and offset.

methods.name: recordIDs
methods.description: Stores a specific set of record IDs and total count into the session for a module.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Clears stored query results from the session for a specific module.
